title: Sleepy ladybug
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- leaf bed -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='40' ry='13' fill='#2f8f3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='36' ry='10' fill='#57c25e'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='72' rx='10' ry='4' fill='#8fe08f'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='26' y='62' width='16' height='6' rx='3' fill='#3b2a55'/>
  <rect x='58' y='62' width='16' height='6' rx='3' fill='#3b2a55'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='26' ry='21' fill='#e8402c'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='26' ry='21' fill='none' stroke='#b02418' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- wing split -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='38' width='3' height='34' rx='1.5' fill='#8f1a12'/>
  <!-- spots -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='48' r='6' fill='#26161f'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='48' r='6' fill='#26161f'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='64' r='5' fill='#26161f'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='64' r='5' fill='#26161f'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#2a1a24'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='35' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#3a2436'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M42 26 Q36 14 30 12' stroke='#3a2436' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 26 Q64 14 70 12' stroke='#3a2436' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='29' cy='11' r='3' fill='#f0a020'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='11' r='3' fill='#f0a020'/>
  <!-- sleepy eyes -->
  <path d='M38 33 Q42 37 46 33' stroke='#f5e9c8' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 33 Q58 37 62 33' stroke='#f5e9c8' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 42 Q50 45 55 42' stroke='#f5e9c8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- zzz -->
  <path d='M74 30 h7 l-7 7 h7' stroke='#a9d8ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M82 20 h6 l-6 6 h6' stroke='#a9d8ff' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M88 11 h5 l-5 5 h5' stroke='#a9d8ff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
</svg>
